tasks.title: Consolidate the native-v1 candidate boundary
tasks.intent: Make the exact proposed stable protocol surface reviewable from current implementation and evidence without freezing it.
requirements: Inventory the existing task, planning, identity, hash, lifecycle, evidence, extension and ledger contracts. Distinguish proposed stable core, alpha compatibility envelopes, storage/wire adapters and project capabilities.

Map the candidate invariants to exact existing conformance identities and retain historical dialect/provenance meaning. Identify gaps honestly; do not change protocol behavior to make a document simpler.

Keep the small typed core, orthogonal task/roadmap/epic indexes, narrow provider authority and explicit revision-aware observations. A candidate document is not native v1 adoption or a freeze decision.
acceptance: A reviewable candidate and compatibility matrix name the selected boundaries and exact executable witnesses, with mechanically checked source/test links.
Current alpha guides no longer claim completed features are missing; dated historical evidence remains unchanged.

tasks.title: Publish the post-checkpoint alpha.3 distributions
tasks.intent: Expose the proved corrections as a new immutable native/JVM consumer release with accurate compatibility notes.
requirements: Use clean exact source and matching three-platform native/JVM corpus, packaged parity, bootstrap and provenance inputs. Preserve Apache-2.0 notices and all old release bytes.

Publish 0.3.0-alpha.3 only after real GitHub draft transport checks pass. Generated locks prefer native and retain an explicit JVM reference; no protocol semantics, implicit state rewrite or consumer migration is introduced.
Keep experimental kernel/IDL dependencies outside the CLI artifacts. Notes distinguish newly available alpha envelopes from the unfrozen v1 candidate.
acceptance: Linux x86_64, Windows x86_64 and macOS aarch64 pass native/JVM behavioral and process parity, clean bootstrap and offline cached operation against the exact release artifacts.
The immutable published release, source tag, checksums, implementation/build identities, locks and signed release asset attestations agree. No unexecuted signature or SLSA claim is made.

tasks.title: Dogfood the published alpha.3 pin
tasks.intent: Accept the new public release through the producer pin and a source-free disposable consumer.
requirements: Update only the producer toolchain lock and any required canonical launcher changes from verified published artifacts; retain native task state and historical evidence meanings.
Prove cold acquisition, version without acquisition, source-free and JVM-free native use, offline cached reads, and bounded inspectable mutations in disposable specimens.
Do not update pins or tasking state in other consumer repositories.
acceptance: The exact public pin passes producer doctor/context/frontier/status and preserves all task contracts, history and receipt identities.
Cold and offline consumer evidence binds the released archive and lock digests and records repository bytes/mtime preservation for read commands.

tasks.title: Package the canonical alpha.3 Linux artifact for Fedora
tasks.intent: Offer an optional Fedora RPM of the parity-proven Linux native release without rebuilding its implementation.
requirements: Package the exact canonical Linux native artifact, retaining PATH integration, metadata, docs, Apache-2.0 notices and the distinction between global taskctl and repository pins.
Install, upgrade and erase must not contact the network, initialize projects or alter repository-local .agents/.taskctl or unrelated user data.
Publish a separate immutable RPM companion with checksum/provenance coverage; it must not block or replace tar.gz/wrapper delivery. No COPR or Fedora inclusion work.
acceptance: A clean current Fedora environment passes install, version/help, greenfield init, doctor/frontier, upgrade, erase, package-content checks and rpmlint with documented dispositions.
The packaged executable matches the canonical artifact and the source RPM rebuilds offline; published companion evidence and assets agree.

roadmaps.title: Candidate specification and alpha.3 delivery
roadmaps.intent: Turn the completed protocol assessment into a reviewable boundary and an independently accepted consumer release.
